children: BlockBeats reported on August 31 that an address beginning with 0x13da kept opening long positions in SOL from Sunday at 23:15 until completing its position build at 08:44 today. According to BlockBeats On-chain Detection, the address bought 282,700 SOL in total, with a transaction value of about $29.623 million and a weighted average execution price of about $104.794.
Over the past 24 hours, larger newly opened positions have already been closed. As of press time, the address had become the largest one-way new position opened since the weekend.

The address’s current SOL long position is valued at about $28.805 million, with an unrealized loss of about $818,100 and a return rate of about -8.28%. Its liquidation price is about $71.66, and the account’s net asset value is about $9.055 million.

title: Address Beginning With 0x13da Builds Largest New SOL Long Since the Weekend
